## Attribution checklist (see CONTRIBUTING.md)

- [ ] Links point to the **upstream** repo, not a copy
- [ ] Author credited by GitHub handle; for forks, the original author is credited too
- [ ] Description is in my own words; any quote is ≤ 1 sentence, in quotation marks, linked
- [ ] License copied exactly from upstream (SPDX ID), or marked `No license — link only` / `Unclear — see repo`
- [ ] `Checked` date is today
- [ ] Entry is correctly marked **Official** (lives in this org, Anyka maintains it) or **Community**
- [ ] No third-party copy of an Anyka SDK/datasheet is listed, and nothing internal is published without release approval
- [ ] I will notify the author (or this PR is a removal/correction they asked for)
